plan.notes: Source: UAFS 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog program page (poid=1262). CREDIT DISCREPANCY: the catalog footer states 120 total hours but the semester listing sums to 119: Semester 1 prints 16 but courses total 15, Semester 7 prints 12 but courses total 13, Semester 8 prints 14 but courses total 13; per collection rule total_credits = sequenced sum = 119. Additional degree requirements 31 hrs (minor of at least 18 hrs required). World language 8 hrs through Beginning II. Transcribed 2026-10-01 from a live-browser harvest of the official catalog.
